description.value: Vancouver Traveller Bed & Breakfast is a family-run, low-carbon-footprint B&B custom-built in 2016 and operated by sisters Linda and Jenny in Vancouver's West Side. The house uses geothermal in-floor heating and cooling, and every guest room features an en-suite bathroom, sofa bed for a third guest, and cross-ventilation windows. Hosts pride themselves on deep local knowledge and a warm, personal atmosphere in a pet-free and smoke-free home.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and content-rich, confirming address, email, two phone numbers, and room amenities in detail. Wi-Fi is confirmed both by OSM tags (internet_access=wlan, internet_access:fee=no) and the website ('free wi-fi' on homepage; 'Wi-Fi' listed on both room pages). No mention of bike storage, bike-handling procedures, laundry, tools, or any cycling-specific facilities appears anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so all those fields are null. Luggage storage is confirmed via the FAQ page, which explicitly describes guests leaving bags in the living room at arrival and after check-out.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; website lists two numbers — Landline: 604-435-3826 and Cell/Whatsapp: 604-375-6182 — landline used as primary phone in output.
OSM address ('2159 West 21st Avenue') is incomplete; full postal address from website ('2159 W. 21st Avenue Vancouver, BC V6L 1J2') used instead.
Laneway Cottage is listed in site navigation but its page content was not included in the fetched content; it may offer additional amenities relevant to cyclists.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is an active, well-presented B&B, but neither secure bike storage nor staff bike-handling knowledge is mentioned anywhere on the website; both required WWC criteria are unconfirmed and require direct inquiry before the listing can be included.
enrichment_extras.notes: The Laneway Cottage subpage was not captured in the prefetch; if it has a private entrance or yard, it could potentially accommodate bike storage — worth checking directly.

Device charging.detail: Type B 120V Electrical Sockets listed as a room amenity on both the King-Sized Room and Queen-Sized Room pages

Luggage storage.detail: FAQ states guests may leave luggage in the living room on arrival if the room is not yet ready, and again after check-out until a later flight
